# Final Review Proposal
**Producer:** agent:codex/gpt-5.4

## Summary

Reviewed the budget-tracking and save-migration changes end-to-end and ran `cargo test -p tank_core`. I found one robustness issue in the new save-version parsing; otherwise I did not find additional correctness or safety problems in the reviewed code.

## Amendments

1. `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:117-121` parses `schema_version` with `Value::as_u64()` and then truncates it with `as u32`. That wraps out-of-range JSON integers instead of rejecting them. For example, a malformed/future save with `schema_version = 4294967299` becomes `3`, so it can bypass the new-version guard and be treated as a current-schema save. Parse with an explicit bounds check/`try_into()` and add a regression test alongside the version-error coverage in `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs:230-300`.
   Rationale: This is a robustness bug in the new migration gate: incompatible or corrupted save files can be misclassified and potentially accepted instead of failing with `SchemaVersionTooNew`.
